services.name: summer camp
services.desc: Join us for Summer Camp! Each week camp will feature a variety of on site activities Gymnastics & Ninja plus themed arts & crafts! We start the morning off with guided instruction in the gym followed by open gym time to practice what each camper enjoys most! Mid morning we break for hand washing, healthy snacks, arts & crafts projects & sidewalk chalk. Camp wraps up the morning back in the gym to burn off some summer energy and excitement and to continue working on skills we learned earlier in the day!
